oil.when: 2009 with the message center SETUP and RESET buttons
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Press SETUP to enter the setup menu, then keep pressing SETUP until the oil life item appears. It is the last item in the menu.
Press RESET once. The display asks HOLD RESET IF NEW OIL.
Press and hold RESET for more than two seconds. The display confirms oil life is set to 100%.
oil.note: Tapping RESET again while OIL LIFE SET TO XXX% is showing lowers the starting value 10% per tap. Leave it at 100% unless your shop advised otherwise.

tpms.when: 2009 (sensor in each road wheel, no reset button)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the sticker in the driver's door opening.
Drive above 20 mph for at least two minutes. The light should then go out by itself.
If the tires are set correctly, the spare is not on the vehicle, and the light stays on, have the system checked.
tpms.note: If the light flashes for about a minute at start-up and then stays on, that is a system fault that driving or adding air will not clear. The spare has no sensor, so the light stays on while it is fitted.

notes: The Mountaineer is a twin of the Ford Explorer of the same years.
